# Domain Expertise: Pharmacy & Prescription Drug Management

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Resources](../../README.md) • [Job Descriptions](../README.md) • [Domain Expertise](./README.md)**

---

> This document defines the Medicaid pharmacy domain expertise requirements for architects working on **Gainwell Rx™** and related pharmacy solutions supporting state Medicaid programs, CHIP, and other government healthcare programs.

---
page_texts.3:
[resources/job-descriptions/domain-expertise/pharmacy.md#gainwell-pharmacy-solutions]

### Gainwell Pharmacy Solutions

**Gainwell Rx™** provides comprehensive pharmacy benefits management and clinical oversight for state Medicaid programs, including:

- **Pharmacy Benefits Management (PBM)**: Claims adjudication, formulary management, pricing, and rebate processing
- **Prior Authorization**: Clinical review workflows and automated approval systems
- **Drug Utilization Review (DUR)**: OBRA '90 mandated clinical screening (prospective and retrospective)
- **Rebate Management**: Medicaid Drug Rebate Program (MDRP) invoicing and reconciliation
- **Specialty Pharmacy Coordination**: High-cost medication management and clinical support programs
page_texts.4:
[resources/job-descriptions/domain-expertise/pharmacy.md#medicaid-program-focus]

### Medicaid Program Focus

All pharmacy expertise must be grounded in **Medicaid and government program** context:

- **Medicaid Fee-For-Service (FFS)** and **Managed Care** pharmacy benefits
- **CHIP** (Children's Health Insurance Program) pharmacy coverage
- **State-specific requirements**: Preferred Drug Lists (PDL), supplemental rebates, clinical programs
- **Federal regulations**: CMS oversight, MDRP compliance, OBRA '90 mandates
- **Dual eligibles**: Coordination between Medicare Part D and Medicaid

page_texts.6:
[resources/job-descriptions/domain-expertise/pharmacy.md#foundational-knowledge-all-architects]

### Foundational Knowledge (All Architects)

Essential understanding for any architect working on pharmacy solutions:
page_texts.7:
[resources/job-descriptions/domain-expertise/pharmacy.md#pharmacy-operations]

#### Pharmacy Operations

- Real-time pharmacy claim adjudication (NCPDP standards D.0, 5.1)
- Point-of-sale (POS) transaction processing and response codes
- Formulary structures and drug classification systems (NDC, GPI, therapeutic class)
- Prior authorization workflows and clinical criteria
- Drug pricing methodologies (MAC, AWP, FUL, state MAC lists)
page_texts.8:
[resources/job-descriptions/domain-expertise/pharmacy.md#medicaid-pharmacy-regulations]

#### Medicaid Pharmacy Regulations

- **Medicaid Drug Rebate Program (MDRP)**: Federal and supplemental rebate calculations
- **OBRA '90**: Drug Utilization Review requirements (prospective and retrospective)
- **State Preferred Drug Lists (PDL)**: Formulary restrictions and PA requirements
- **CMS reporting**: MARx (Medicaid Analytic eXtract), SURS (State Utilization Review)
- **340B Drug Pricing**: Discount program tracking and claim splitting
page_texts.9:
[resources/job-descriptions/domain-expertise/pharmacy.md#technical-standards]

#### Technical Standards

- **NCPDP Telecommunication**: Real-time claim submission standards
- **NCPDP SCRIPT**: E-prescribing message standards
- **HL7 FHIR**: Emerging pharmacy interoperability (MedicationRequest, MedicationDispense)
- **CMS interfaces**: MDRP reporting, drug pricing files (AMP, Best Price)
page_texts.10:
[resources/job-descriptions/domain-expertise/pharmacy.md#intermediate-knowledge-solutionapplication-architects]

### Intermediate Knowledge (Solution/Application Architects)

Deeper expertise for architects designing and implementing pharmacy systems:
page_texts.11:
[resources/job-descriptions/domain-expertise/pharmacy.md#system-architecture]

#### System Architecture

- High-volume transaction processing (sub-second POS response times)
- Drug database integration (Medi-Span, First DataBank)
- Clinical decision support engines (DUR, drug interactions, duplicate therapy)
- Prior authorization workflow systems and document management
- Financial reconciliation and rebate calculation engines
page_texts.12:
[resources/job-descriptions/domain-expertise/pharmacy.md#integration-patterns]

#### Integration Patterns

- Real-time eligibility verification integration
- Pharmacy network connectivity (via switches like Change Healthcare)
- State MMIS interfaces for claims and financial reconciliation
- CMS system integration (MDRP, MARx reporting)
- Provider portal and prescriber EHR integrations
page_texts.13:
[resources/job-descriptions/domain-expertise/pharmacy.md#state-implementation-variations]

#### State Implementation Variations

- State-specific formulary and PA requirements
- Supplemental rebate agreements and calculations
- State clinical programs (opioid limits, lock-in programs)
- State pharmacy network management
- State-specific reporting and audit requirements
page_texts.14:
[resources/job-descriptions/domain-expertise/pharmacy.md#advanced-knowledge-seniorenterprise-architects]

### Advanced Knowledge (Senior/Enterprise Architects)

Strategic and comprehensive expertise for senior architecture roles:
page_texts.15:
[resources/job-descriptions/domain-expertise/pharmacy.md#enterprise-pharmacy-strategy]

#### Enterprise Pharmacy Strategy

- Multi-state pharmacy platform architecture and standardization
- Pharmacy data architecture and analytics (utilization, rebate optimization, adherence)
- Modernization strategies (legacy to cloud, MMIS integration)
- Value-based pharmacy contracting and outcomes measurement
- Emerging technology evaluation (AI/ML, FHIR adoption, digital therapeutics)
page_texts.16:
[resources/job-descriptions/domain-expertise/pharmacy.md#program-expertise]

#### Program Expertise

- Specialty pharmacy program design and vendor integration
- Dual eligible coordination (Medicare Part D and Medicaid)
- 340B program compliance and claim splitting logic
- Managed care pharmacy carve-in/carve-out strategies
- Cost containment strategies while maintaining access
page_texts.17:
[resources/job-descriptions/domain-expertise/pharmacy.md#regulatory-and-policy-leadership]

#### Regulatory and Policy Leadership

- CMS guidance interpretation and implementation
- State Medicaid agency consultation and policy recommendations
- MDRP optimization and audit support
- Legislative changes impact analysis (drug pricing legislation)
- Industry trends and best practices (AMCP, NCPDP standards development)

page_texts.19:
[resources/job-descriptions/domain-expertise/pharmacy.md#level-1-foundational-0-2-years-domain-experience]

### Level 1: Foundational (0-2 years domain experience)

**Knowledge Base**:

- Basic understanding of Medicaid pharmacy claim flow
- Familiarity with NCPDP standards and transaction formats
- Awareness of State PDLs and prior authorization concepts
- Understanding of MDRP basics

**Project Experience**:

- Participated in pharmacy system projects
- Supported Medicaid PBM integration or testing
- Documented pharmacy workflows and requirements

**Typical Roles**: Application Architect, Solution Architect (pharmacy novice)
page_texts.20:
[resources/job-descriptions/domain-expertise/pharmacy.md#level-2-intermediate-2-5-years-domain-experience]

### Level 2: Intermediate (2-5 years domain experience)

**Knowledge Base**:

- Deep understanding of NCPDP transaction processing
- Experience with formulary management and clinical edits
- Knowledge of drug pricing methodologies and MDRP calculations
- Familiarity with state-specific pharmacy requirements

**Project Experience**:

- Led pharmacy system integration or enhancement projects
- Designed PA workflows or formulary solutions
- Implemented MDRP rebate processing or reporting

**Typical Roles**: Solution Architect, Application Architect, Data Architect (pharmacy focus)
page_texts.21:
[resources/job-descriptions/domain-expertise/pharmacy.md#level-3-advanced-5-10-years-domain-experience]

### Level 3: Advanced (5-10 years domain experience)

**Knowledge Base**:

- Expert knowledge of PBM platform architectures
- Deep expertise in Medicaid pharmacy regulations and CMS requirements
- Advanced understanding of specialty pharmacy and complex programs
- Comprehensive rebate optimization and financial management knowledge

**Project Experience**:

- Led enterprise pharmacy platform implementations or modernization
- Architected multi-state pharmacy solutions
- Designed pharmacy data warehouse and analytics platforms
- Led complex pharmacy integrations (PBM vendors, specialty, prescribers)

**Typical Roles**: Senior Enterprise Architect, Principal Architect, Enterprise Architect
page_texts.22:
[resources/job-descriptions/domain-expertise/pharmacy.md#level-4-expert-10-years-domain-experience]

### Level 4: Expert (10+ years domain experience)

**Knowledge Base**:

- Authoritative expertise across all pharmacy solution domains
- Industry thought leadership and standards contribution
- Strategic vision for pharmacy technology and policy
- Deep understanding of emerging trends and innovations

**Project Experience**:

- Led transformational pharmacy initiatives across multiple states
- Defined enterprise pharmacy architecture strategy and roadmap
- Advised state Medicaid agencies on pharmacy benefit optimization
- Contributed to industry standards (NCPDP) or published thought leadership

**Typical Roles**: Distinguished Architect, Chief Architect, Senior Enterprise Architect

page_texts.24:
[resources/job-descriptions/domain-expertise/pharmacy.md#technical-competencies]

### Technical Competencies

- **High-Volume Transaction Processing**: Design for real-time, sub-second pharmacy claim adjudication
- **Integration Architecture**: Connect PBM systems, drug databases, state MMIS, CMS interfaces
- **Clinical Rules Engines**: Implement DUR, PA automation, and clinical decision support
- **Financial Systems**: Rebate calculation, invoice generation, payment reconciliation
- **Data Architecture**: Pharmacy data warehousing, utilization analytics, reporting
page_texts.25:
[resources/job-descriptions/domain-expertise/pharmacy.md#regulatory--compliance]

### Regulatory & Compliance

- **CMS Compliance**: MDRP reporting, federal regulations, audit requirements
- **State Requirements**: PDL management, PA criteria, supplemental rebates, clinical programs
- **HIPAA**: Pharmacy transaction standards, data privacy, security requirements
- **Audit Support**: Documentation, financial reconciliation, program integrity
page_texts.26:
[resources/job-descriptions/domain-expertise/pharmacy.md#business-domain]

### Business Domain

- **Medicaid Operations**: Understanding of FFS vs managed care pharmacy delivery models
- **Stakeholder Management**: State agencies, pharmacy networks, providers, members, manufacturers
- **Cost Management**: Rebate optimization, formulary strategies, utilization management
- **Quality & Outcomes**: Medication adherence, quality measures, population health
